name: Electronic USD
oneLiner: EUSD is a Reserve Protocol RToken backed by a basket of yield-bearing Aave and Compound USDC/USDT lending positions, with RSR stakers as first-loss buffer.
collateral: Diversified basket of yield-bearing stablecoin derivatives: Aave V3 USDC, Compound V3 USDC, and Compound V3 USDT; RSR stakers provide first-loss overcollateralization
pegMechanism: Permissionless 1:1 mint and redemption against underlying collateral basket; RSR stakers absorb first losses in case of collateral default; basket rebalances via Dutch/batch auctions

oracleRisk.summary: EUSD is a Reserve Protocol RToken whose collateral plugins (Aave V3 USDC, Compound V3 USDC/USDT) use Chainlink price feeds for default detection: a defaultThreshold/delayUntilDefault state machine moves collateral SOUND -> IFFY -> DISABLED and triggers mechanistic RSR-staker seizure. Pricing uses standard single-source Chainlink feeds per asset with oracleError bounds and basket warmup; no redundant cross-provider failover is documented.

branchApplicability.rationale: EUSD is issued and redeemed 1:1 against a shared RToken basket. Reserve Protocol responds to collateral default by switching the basket, rebalancing through auctions, and using staked RSR as overcollateralization; users do not open borrower-specific debt positions with liquidatable collateral branches.

applicabilityBasis.summary: Electronic USD is a Reserve Protocol RToken with on-chain basket collateral and governance rather than a legal fiat issuer.

genius.issuerEntity: Electronic Dollar governance / Reserve Protocol RToken governors
genius.notes: eUSD is stablecoin-adjacent but protocol-governed; no public GENIUS approval or issuer pathway source was found. The payment use case via RPay (Latin America) makes applicability genuinely unclear rather than a clean non-payment-token exclusion.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception source was located for eUSD. No GENIUS approvals have been granted to any issuer as of 2026-06-18; rulemaking remains at NPRM stage.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-30 against the verified RTokenP1 implementation, Reserve documentation, and live Ethereum state. The deployed RToken transfer path rejects transfer-to-self but has no holder blacklist, freeze, seizure, or transfer-pause function, and the reserve basket's inherited USDC/USDT freeze exposure is unchanged. At Ethereum block 25,652,077, however, the Central Auth 0xe1ec57c8ee970280f237863910b606059e9641c9 still reported exactly one DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member, the 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe 0xe8259842e71f4E44F2F68D6bfbC15EDA56E63064 (getThreshold() = 3 over the same five owners, no timelock), and the eUSD proxy 0xa0d69e286b938e21cbf7e51d71f6a4c8918f482f still resolved to the upgradeable RTokenP1 implementation 0x258ce833cf9ad19208372763a00aa1565dd40b3c. That Safe can grant itself OWNER and replace the token implementation with no delay, so holder-control functionality can be introduced instantly. The Yes result is therefore an established upgrade-control capability, not a claim that a blacklist is presently deployed.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Kimi safety-v9 W2 T54 access review

mintAuthority.summary: EUSD is a Reserve Protocol RToken: permissionless 1:1 basket mint/redeem. Protocol-level controls (pause, freeze, basket changes) require OWNER/PAUSER/FREEZER roles on a central Auth contract whose DEFAULT_ADMIN is a 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe; no on-chain timelock.

controls.label: eUSD RToken (permissionless basket mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint is 1:1 against the current collateral basket only; supply is bounded by deposited collateral, with arbitrage holding the peg.
controls.evidence: At block 25,294,956, RToken proxy UUPS. main() = 0x7697ae4def3c3cd52493ba3a6f57fc6d8c59108a (Main v4 implementation 0xc5bf686cfb85786fcfff557297d4aff8f4e15e44). Minting is permissionless via RToken.issue().

controls.label: eUSD Central Auth (DEFAULT_ADMIN = 3-of-5 Gnosis Safe)
controls.evidence: Central Auth 0xe1ec57c8… confirmed: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE count=1 → 0xe8259842… (Gnosis Safe L2 v1.3.0, 3-of-5, nonce 31, no modules). OWNER/PAUSER/FREEZER roles: 0 holders. No TimelockController present; docs-stated 7-day timelock was not deployed. Safe can grant itself OWNER instantly. Observed block 25,294,956.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25,294,956: eUSD RToken main = 0x7697ae4def3c3cd52493ba3a6f57fc6d8c59108a (UUPS, Main v4). Central Auth 0xe1ec57c8…: DEFAULT_ADMIN = 0xe8259842… (Gnosis Safe L2 v1.3.0, 3-of-5, no modules). No OWNER/PAUSER/FREEZER holders. No TimelockController on-chain (prior docs reference was inaccurate). Permissionless mint confirmed. Re-verified at Ethereum block 25575142 on 2026-07-20: Safe 0xe8259842e71f4E44F2F68D6bfbC15EDA56E63064 still returns getThreshold()=3 over the same five owners, getModulesPaginated returned an empty array, and the Safe guard slot reads zero; Auth 0xe1ec57c8ee970280f237863910b606059e9641c9 still reports exactly one DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member, that Safe. RToken 0xa0d69e286b938e21cbf7e51d71f6a4c8918f482f remains a UUPS proxy (EIP-1967 implementation slot = 0x258ce833cf9ad19208372763a00aa1565dd40b3c) whose main() is 0x7697aE4dEf3C3Cd52493Ba3a6F57fc6d8c59108a. Economic-control adjudication: issuance itself is permissionless and 1:1 against deposited collateral, but the same 3-of-5 Safe can grant itself OWNER instantly, change the basket, and upgrade the RToken implementation with no timelock and no independent bound, so the cap is economically unbounded rather than raiseable (this is the point of difference from the Reserve Protocol sibling USD3, which routes OWNER_ROLE through a 3-day TimelockController). The basket is held on-chain and continuously readable, so there is no off-chain supply-versus-reserve attestation cadence, and no financial regulator supervises the eUSD RToken.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: eUSD is Ethereum-native (Reserve RToken); its Base and Arbitrum deployments are canonical-rollup-bridge lock-mint representations (Base L2StandardBridge and the Arbitrum Nitro token bridge, controller contracts read on-chain 2026-07-19/20).

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: eUSD is an Ethereum RToken with permissionless basket mint (mint-authority review 2026-06-11).

Canonical Base bridge representation: the Base token's bridge() returns the Base L2StandardBridge predeploy 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000010 (read 2026-07-20); L1 eUSD is escrowed in the corresponding L1StandardBridge on Ethereum. DefiLlama classifies the deployment bridgedFromETH.

Canonical Arbitrum Nitro token-bridge representation: the L2 token exposes the IArbToken surface with l1Address() = L1 eUSD and l2Gateway() = the Arbitrum L2GatewayRouter 0x09e9222E96E7B4AE2a407B98d48e330053351EEe (read 2026-07-19); the L1 escrow is the canonical L1ERC20Gateway 0xa3A7B6F88361F48403514059F1F16C8E78d60EeC per the L1 GatewayRouter.

sources.label: eUSD Arbitrum token (Arbitrum IArbToken surface, read 2026-07-19)

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: EUSD is a redeemable Reserve Protocol basket token backed by stablecoin lending positions; RSR is first-loss capital, not borrower collateral.
